In a game against the Raiders, Ja'Quan McMillian made a one-handed interception and returned it for a touchdown.

excerpts:
# McMillian's pick-6 helps Broncos spoil career nights by Winston and Jeudy and beat Browns 41-32

By AP

Dec 3, 2024, 09:43 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

DENVER -- — [Jameis Winston](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/2969939/jameis-winston) had a night to remember — and one to forget.

Ja’Quan McMillian [returned an interception 44 yards](https://x.com/NFL/status/1863804452547019180) for a game-sealing touchdown with 1:48 remaining, and Denver spoiled career-best performances by Winston and [former Broncos wide receiver](https://apnews.com/article/jerry-jeudy-browns-broncos-jameis-winston-5b817a915356269d9451a0aff4e98c65) [Jerry Jeudy](http://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4241463/jerry-jeudy) in beating the [Cleveland Browns](http://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/cle/cleveland-browns) 41-32 on Monday night.

The good for Winston: He threw for a [franchise-record 497 yards](https://x.com/OptaSTATS/status/1863813213382410641) and four touchdowns.
